# nix-configs

<!-- Generated by `nix run .#write-files`. Edit `modules/docs/`, not this file. -->

My NixOS, Home Manager and Nixvim configuration.

It follows [the dendritic pattern](https://github.com/mightyiam/dendritic): every `.nix` file under
`modules/` is a [flake-parts](https://flake.parts) module, auto-imported by
[import-tree](https://github.com/vic/import-tree). Nothing is registered by hand - `flake.nix` itself
is generated by [flake-file](https://github.com/vic/flake-file).

Modules are composed through four option trees:

| Option | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `nixos.modules.<name>` | NixOS modules |
| `home.modules.<name>` | Home Manager modules |
| `home.user-modules.<user>.<name>` | per-user Home Manager modules |
| `nixvim.user-modules.<user>.<name>` | per-user Nixvim modules |

## Home Manager

`homeConfigurations` are named `<config>@<system>`.

| Config | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `john` | CLI + GUI — browsers, fonts, CAD, notetaking, social |
| `john@kv` | CLI + GUI, different git identity |
| `john[cli]` | CLI only — shell, git, programming, cloud, networking, secrets |
| `john[cli]@kv` | CLI only, different git identity |

Systems: `x86_64-linux`, `aarch64-linux`, `armv6l-linux`, `armv7l-linux`, `i686-linux`, `aarch64-darwin`, `powerpc64le-linux`, `riscv64-linux`, `x86_64-freebsd`.

Quote the fragment — the names contain `[`, `]` and `@`.

```sh
# activate
home-manager switch --flake '.#john@x86_64-linux'

# build without activating
nix build '.#homeConfigurations."john@x86_64-linux".activationPackage'
./result/activate
```

## NixOS

`nixosConfigurations` are named after the host.

| Host | Machine | Users |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lt14s` | ThinkPad — GUI, gaming, docking, printing, fingerprint, audio, virtualization | `john`, `john-kv` |

```sh
# activate
sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#lt14s

# build / preview only
nixos-rebuild build --flake .#lt14s
nixos-rebuild dry-activate --flake .#lt14s
```

A host's `users` entry creates the system account only. Home Manager is activated separately,
with the commands above.

## Nixvim

Each `nixvimConfigurations.<name>` is exposed as a package, and optionally as a Home Manager
and/or NixOS module.

| Config | System | Home module | NixOS module |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `john-nvim` | `x86_64-linux` | `home.modules.john-nvim` | `nixos.modules.john-nvim` |

```sh
nix run .#john-nvim
```

The home module is already imported by `home.user-modules.john.programming`, so every `john*`
home configuration ships it.

### Modules

- `john`: `auto`, `autopairs`, `base`, `clipboard`, `cmp`, `conform`, `debug`, `diagnostics`, `git`, `git-for-buffers`, `git-wrapper`, `globals`, `harpoon`, `indent-utils`, `keymaps`, `linting`, `lsp`, `mini`, `minuet`, `multicursor`, `neotree`, `options`, `rustaceanvim`, `secrets`, `telescope`, `themes`, `todo-comments`, `treesitter`, `which-key`

`base` is the aggregate; the rest live under `modules/users/<user>/nixvim/`.

### Adding a plugin

Create `modules/users/john/nixvim/plugins/<name>.nix`:

```nix
{
  nixvim.user-modules.john.<name> = {
    plugins.<name>.enable = true;
  };
}
```

Then add `<name>` to the `imports` list in `modules/users/john/nixvim/default.nix`.

### Secrets

An age file declared under `nixvim.age.secrets` is bridged into `age.secrets` and decrypted at
runtime into the Lua global `agenix_secrets`. Declared: `api-ai-gemini`, `api-ai-openai`.

```nix
nixvim.age.secrets.api-ai-gemini.file = "${inputs.john-nvim-secrets}/api-ai-gemini.age";
```

```nix
api_key.__raw = ''function() return agenix_secrets["api-ai-gemini"] end'';
```

## Contributing

- **Add a module** — drop a `.nix` file anywhere under `modules/`. It is imported automatically.
  Only aggregate modules (`core`, `gui`, `base`, …) need an explicit entry in their `imports` list.
- **Add a flake input** — declare it in the module that uses it, then regenerate `flake.nix`:

  ```nix
  flake-file.inputs.foo.url = "github:owner/foo";
  ```

  ```sh
  nix run .#write-flake
  ```

- **Update inputs** — `nix flake update` (or `nix flake update <input>`).
- **Format** — `nix run nixpkgs#nixfmt -- .`; 2-space indent, LF, trailing newline
  (see `.editorconfig`).
- **Check before committing** — `nix flake check`, plus a build of whatever you touched.

### Generated files

`README.md` and `flake.nix` are generated. Don't edit them; edit the modules that describe them
and regenerate:

```sh
nix run .#write-files   # README.md, from modules/docs/
nix run .#write-flake   # flake.nix, from every flake-file.inputs declaration
```

`nix flake check` fails when either is out of date.
